C1150.title: Italian Regulator Fined Foodinho Over Rider-Management Algorithm Violations
C1150.summary: In July 2021, Italy's Data Protection Authority announced a EUR 2.6 million fine against Foodinho, a Glovo group company. The investigation found that the platform used algorithms to manage about 19,000 riders without adequately explaining its data processing and automated decision logic or implementing sufficient safeguards against discriminatory or inaccurate outcomes. The regulator ordered changes to its algorithmic and data-management practices and required protections for riders seeking to challenge decisions.
